summary: Scout org map — hit list slow on wide date ranges and row limit is undocumented
acceptance_criteria: The actual row limits, both query-side and render-side, are determined and documented
Where a cap exists, the UI indicates that results are truncated
Load time for 7, 15 and 30 day ranges is measured on a high-volume account against an agreed target
A loading indicator is shown while a range is being fetched

intake_findings.recent_hits_cap: recentHits() uses limitBy(1,ocr)->limit(20); no capped flag in JSON
intake_findings.frontend: map.js mentions rangeHitsCapped for map hits; DashboardOverlay Live Hits list uses recentHits (20) — verify truncation UI
